text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After hearing from Buena Vista's fans, we 
decided to hold a meet-and-greet event to 
cheer her up from her slump.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Preparing behind the scenes of our 
training, the day of the event arrived... 
Buena Vista's expression was just a little 
clouded.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Debates among the fans over the outcome of 
that race are still fiercely ongoing. We 
are taking all possible measures, such as 
increasing security.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, what weighs on her heart is 
likely not that sort of anxiety, but—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...What if nobody came?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Because I've let down so many people...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list:
Even so... I need to believe in everything 
I've done up until now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: The me up until now...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everything was in place, and it was time 
for the event. Perhaps afraid to face 
reality, Buena Vista squeezed her eyes 
shut tightly...

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Buena Vistaaa!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What welcomed Buena Vista was... the same 
warm cheers from her fans as always.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Everyone... So... many of you...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Why...? Even though I betrayed you...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Still, though... Isn't that because you 
were trying to live up to our 
expectations?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Because... Buena-chan has always been that 
way.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That's right! We've been watching you all 
along. So everyone knows!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You were always giving it your all, 
putting everything into it...! The sight 
of you running—

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
You ran so many races and brought us so 
much joy! Your pure, bright smile was—

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Everything you showed me— was truly a 
magnificent sight...!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
...It's stayed in my heart ever since. 
Just like... a breathtaking view.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
We…… wanted you to win so badly…… that we 
kept demanding more and more— "That race!" 
"This race too!"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
“Still... winning is important, of course, 
but... it's not the most important thing. 
What I've always wanted to convey is—”

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: "I want to beat you... and see you smile."

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...If this is what happened as a result of 
all those expectations, won't you let us 
carry that burden with you?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Please let me keep supporting you. Far 
into the distant future... forever and 
always――"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.
choice_data_list:
...This is the result of everything you've 
built up.

...This is the result of everything you've 
built up.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you so much...! Truly, 
thank you...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fans gently watched over the weeping 
Buena Vista. Waiting until she could calm 
down... with nothing but gentleness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, the plan was to have a 
one-minute chat with each fan.

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I was there in person at the 
Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks)...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: My! So that was it, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... But back then, I had a 
disagreement with a coworker about work, 
and I was feeling a bit down about it, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Buena-chan charge through with such 
fierce spirit alongside Desire-chan really 
got my motivation soaring...!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I had a head-on discussion 
with my coworker. And after that, 
everything worked out great...

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
I always get the strength to do my best 
from you, Buena-chan! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Likewise! Thank you so much for your 
support! Please give my regards to your 
coworkers as well!

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text:
For me, seeing Buena-san run with all her 
might among such an amazing lineup at the 
Arima Kinen really left an impression.

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text:
Even against a seasoned upperclassman, she 
dug deep, determined not to lose, and put 
on a brilliant run...

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text:
"I was chosen as a starter for the club 
over the seniors, and I was so nervous... 
but seeing you made me resolve to hang in 
there and give it my all!"

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text:
I'm wearing Buena-san's merch right now 
and giving it my absolute all! Please keep 
showing us how cool you are!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yes! Let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I've been... watching Buena-chan ever 
since her Make Debut.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... You've been watching over me this 
whole time, haven't you? Thank you so 
much!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. She's an Umamusume that 
just makes you want to watch over her.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why. Just seeing you run gets me 
so excited... and whenever you win, I'm 
so, so happy.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Because you're so strong and wonderful. 
Because you gave us so many dreams, I had 
high hopes for records and great 
achievements, but..."

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
――"I want Buena Vista to win." In the 
end... that really is all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although the event ran long, the fans were 
very accommodating, and Buena Vista 
treated everyone with utmost sincerity... 
bringing it to a successful close.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I was truly grateful. So many people came 
out to see me...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Conveying so many feelings to me. So 
many... so very many...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I guess I lost sight of even the most 
obvious things, didn't I?"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The huge, loud cheers that always greet me 
at the racetrack... But it's not just one 
single voice.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Buena Vistaaa!!" "Buena-chaaaan!!" 
"Buenaaaa!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Each and every one holds warmth, and 
carries the unique feelings of that 
person.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Expectations" are... individual pieces of 
love. The heavier they are... the more 
love and the more people's hopes there 
are.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I can carry it all. It's not 
just a heavy mass... but the precious 
weight of each and every single hope.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I... want to spend my whole life 
dedicating myself to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, no matter what 
happens... Even if the era changes, I want 
to be an Umamusume who gathers everyone's 
hopes.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—I want to reach that magnificent view 
together with everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A glint shone in Buena Vista's round eyes. 
They were filled with unwavering 
determination.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother...! *sniff*, Buu-chan won...! 
I won!"

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"Big sis...! *sob*, *sob*, Buu-chan 
won...! I won!"

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"Wah...! Big brother, your eyes are all 
sparkly. If Buu-chan wins... will you be 
happy?"

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"Wah...! Big sister, your eyes are all 
sparkly. If Buu-chan wins... will you be 
happy?"

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"...Then Buu-chan won't lose! I'll run a 
lot, and win a lot—"

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: "I'll make you smile, Big Brother...!"

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: "I'm gonna make Big Sis smile...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Unchanged since long ago. She can become 
infinitely strong for someone else's 
sake... Those eyes reflect Buena Vista's 
pure heart.
choice_data_list:
(I want to support you through 
everything... no matter what.)

(I want to support you through 
everything... no matter what.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Please, let me try one more time!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"In order to stay the Buena Vista everyone 
loves so much... Please make me stronger!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next morning, at the deserted academy— 
at the "promised place" where we signed 
our Trainer contract, I faced Buena Vista 
once again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She vowed to run with all her heart for 
the rest of her life. In that case, as her 
Trainer... I want to show my resolve to 
dedicate everything for her sake as well.
choice_data_list:
There's... one more contract I'd like to 
make with you.

I want to make... one more contract with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with the bond of trust built since 
childhood, I still couldn't reach the 
deepest corners of her heart... And so, I 
ended up leaving her all alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So――I will forge an even stronger bond 
with her once more.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list:
I will dedicate the rest of my Trainer 
life entirely to you.

I will dedicate the rest of my Trainer 
life entirely to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Feeling that words alone weren't enough, 
what I offered as proof of my pledge 
was... my awareness, responsibility, and 
everything I carried as a Trainer—"
choice_data_list:
—I want to leave this fountain pen in your 
care.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...! Isn't that... your precious—
choice_data_list: I'll never let you feel alone ever again.
I won't let you ever feel alone again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My dream started with her from the very 
beginning— If I can support her all the 
way to the very end... I could ask for 
nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, I'm such a crybaby, it's pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“Still... it's fine. Because you'll wipe 
them away for me.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, wait just a moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Buena Vista deftly removed her 
hair ornaments, untied the ribbons braided 
into her hair, and...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Could you hold out your wrist?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I loosely tied the removed ribbon around 
the hand she had extended.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "...This is my answer, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Please, continue walking this path with 
me! Until the day... my legs can run no 
more...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I won't think I'm all alone anymore, 
either. So that together with you, I can 
make our dream come true...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Let's reach that magnificent view 
together, one that touches everyone's 
hearts!
